match.reason: The new point covers both workplace health and safety and equal employment opportunity duties for employers, but the closest bank point, Work health and safety law, covers only WHS and is written for NSW Year 12, so no bank point teaches the same combined idea.

draft.title: Legal obligations for staffing
card: Employers must follow laws when they hire and manage staff. These laws apply to every employer, big or small.
laws require an employer to provide a safe workplace, safe equipment and training, so that workers are not harmed. In Victoria, the main law is the Occupational Health and Safety Act 2004.
laws require an employer to treat people fairly when hiring, promoting and training. Staff must not be treated worse because of things such as their sex, age, race or disability.
An employer who breaks these laws can face penalties, such as fines or legal action.
draft.remember: Employers must keep staff safe and treat people fairly in hiring and work.

a.q: Which duty comes from equal employment opportunity laws?
opts: Choosing staff by skills, not by their age or race
Giving every worker the same wage for any job
Hiring a set number of workers from each group
Making sure the workplace has safe equipment
a.why: Equal employment opportunity laws stop unfair treatment based on things such as age or race. They do not require identical pay for every job or set numbers from each group. Safe equipment comes from workplace health and safety laws.
a.clue: Think about fair treatment, not safety.

b.q: Jo runs a small bakery in Ballarat with four staff. She says the safety laws only apply to large firms. Which is correct?
opts: The laws apply to her, so she must provide a safe workplace
The laws apply only once she employs more than ten staff
The laws apply only to firms that use heavy machinery
The laws apply only if a worker has already been hurt
b.why: These laws set duties for every employer, whatever the size. Jo must keep her workplace safe, such as by training staff to use the ovens and slicers. Waiting for an injury is not what the law allows.
b.clue: The card says the laws apply to every employer.

a.best: Choosing staff by skills, not by their age or race

b.best: The laws apply to her, so she must provide a safe workplace
